tutorial_0: Welcome to your tavern! You will be in charge of managing and growing your business!
tutorial_2: Great job! You can also rotate the camera by holding your right mouse button and moving the mouse around.
tutorial_3: We only have one table in our tavern right now. That won't be enough so let's buy one more by clicking on the dining room button below!
tutorial_4: Let's buy the first table in the list.
tutorial_5: We should now buy 2 benches. Let's open the seats tab.
tutorial_7: You can see that 2 seats on the bench are marked with red which means they are not connected to a table.
tutorial_8: Drag the bench to the marked area and confirm its purchase.
tutorial_9: Great job! We now have enough tables and seats for customers to use! There is only one problem left.
tutorial_10: One of the benches does not have a light source close by which means customers will not use it.
tutorial_11: To see exactly how well our tavern is lit, you can click on this checkbox to show lights.
tutorial_12: We can see that one of the benches is not inside any light range. Let's buy a candle light to fix that.
tutorial_13: Great job! Now that we have enough seats for our guests, next step would be to buy beer to serve.
tutorial_15: We currently only have water to serve. Let's buy another barrel to store the beer.
tutorial_16: To serve the beer we first have to fill the barrel. Click the fill bar to continue!
tutorial_17: Great job! We now have place for people to sit on, we have drinks to serve, final thing missing is to hire staff.
tutorial_19: Every day you'll get new candidates for hiring. Pick one of these 4 by clicking the hire button.
tutorial_20: You should hire a waitress now and we are done!
tutorial_21: We've prepared everything needed for the guests to start coming in. Before we un-pause the time, let's see how you can unlock new stuff for the tavern. Click the research button
tutorial_22: Upgrades are researched by serving different types of guests and you can see the cost of research on the left side of it. For kitchen, we need to serve {0} common guests.
tutorial_23: Our only option right now is to research the kitchen so click on the research button to start. After kitchen is finished, 3 more upgrades will be available for research.
tutorial_24: Number of guests per day tells you how many people will come in to your tavern on average every day. Buy decorations and upgrade your tavern to increase that number.
tutorial_25: We are all set and our tavern can be opened! Click the play button to resume the game and wait for customers to come in!
tutorial_26: My final tip to you is that you watch out if there is enough space to sit. If all the seats are taken, buy more tables and benches. Good luck!

pirateChecklist_task6: Set any chef to focus on expeditions
pirateTutorial_0: Hello and welcome to your very own cozy pirate tavern!
pirateTutorial_1: You probably already know the basics of the game - you buy tables and benches, hire staff and sell drinks and food to expand the tavern. If you’re not familiar with the basics, it’s recommended that you play the normal game mode first.
pirateTutorial_2: There is a new way to unlock stuff on the pirate map. We need to hire pirate crew, prepare food for them and send them to expeditions.
pirateTutorial_3: Let’s first see how your ship looks like.
pirateTutorial_4: This is your pirate ship! It might not look like much, but you can upgrade it to increase its total power in order to complete some future expeditions.
pirateTutorial_5: To start expeditions, we need at least 1 crew member, so let’s hire someone.
pirateTutorial_6: Each pirate gives you a bonus for ship power (<sprite index=27>) and a chance to find a treasure (<sprite index=28>). They also have a salary needed for each day of the expedition and dietary requirements. Let’s hire any of these four pirates.
pirateTutorial_7: Great job! Let’s go back now.
pirateTutorial_8: Let’s start the first expedition now!
pirateTutorial_9: Since your crew member has certain dietary requirements, your chefs will be in charge of preparing some food that’ll be consumed on the expedition.
pirateTutorial_10: This expedition will reward you with a new drink type - grog. Let’s start the preparation immediately!
pirateTutorial_11: Since you already have 2 chefs hired, let’s set one of them to focus on preparing food for expeditions and leave the other one to focus on preparing food for guests.
pirateTutorial_12: Great job! This chef will now prioritize preparing food for expeditions. If there is no expedition that needs food, they will certainly not be idle! There are always hungry guests!
pirateTutorial_13: This is it for now, you’re ready to continue on your own. There is a checklist on top left part of the screen that you’ll have to complete before you’re able to start the new day. Good luck!
